name: Easy LMS
summary: Easy LMS builds and delivers courses and exams, and assigns them to groups. Its reports show who has completed a course and export results to Excel. Its pricing page lists two monthly plans in euros, and the home page also shows dollar figures.

facts.text: The home page says trainers can upload existing material, including SCORM packages, or build content from scratch.
The pricing page lists the feature Assign exams and courses based on group.
The reports page says a user can see immediately who has completed the course, their pass or fail rate, and certificate status.
The reports page says the progress report per group shows which participants have not completed their course or exam yet, and that reminders can be sent to them.
The pricing page lists the feature Export results to Excel. The reports page says detailed data can be exported to Excel, and does not mention CSV.
The pricing page does not show which plan includes each feature in its comparison table.

plans.name: Basic
plans.unit: flat fee per month, billed monthly
plans.notes: Listed at €70 a month, or €700 a year. The home page also shows $80 a month or $800 a year. Figures are shown as listed and not converted.

plans.name: Advanced
plans.unit: flat fee per month, billed monthly
plans.notes: Listed at €200 a month, or €2,000 a year. The home page also shows $230 a month or $2,300 a year. Figures are shown as listed and not converted.

hiddenCosts: The pricing page shows euro and dollar figures, and the page does not say which currency applies to a US buyer.
The pricing page says yearly plans include two months free, and does not state the number of users or learners either plan covers.
The pricing page does not show which plan includes each feature, so confirm tier coverage for group assignment and Excel export.
